description: This file defines the GuzzleHttp Client class, which implements HTTP client functionality including request creation, configuration, and asynchronous/synchronous request handling within the Guzzle HTTP library.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Represents an HTTP client that supports configurable request options, base URI, and handles asynchronous and synchronous HTTP requests by implementing the ClientInterface and PSR-18 ClientInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Client with optional configuration, setting defaults for handler, base URI, and request options.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls for HTTP methods with 'Async' suffix, routing to requestAsync or request accordingly.

methods.name: sendAsync
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request asynchronously, returning a PromiseInterface.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request synchronously by waiting for the promise to resolve.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request synchronously following PSR-18 specification.

methods.name: requestAsync
methods.description: Creates and dispatches an asynchronous HTTP request with method, URI, and options.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Creates and sends an HTTP request synchronously with method, URI, and options.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves client configuration options, deprecated in favor of direct property access.

methods.name: buildUri
methods.description: Builds and resolves the URI for requests, combining base URI and IDN conversion as configured.

methods.name: configureDefaults
methods.description: Sets default request options including redirects, errors, content decoding, proxies, and headers.

methods.name: prepareDefaults
methods.description: Merges user-supplied options with default configuration, handling headers and conditional options.

methods.name: transfer
methods.description: Executes the request using the specified handler, returning a promise.

methods.name: applyOptions
methods.description: Modifies the request object with the specified request options like headers, body, query, auth, etc.

methods.name: invalidBody
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating invalid use of array body parameter.
